audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed Irelia wins Levels 2, 3 and 4-5, but the packet levelChart says Skill / Aatrox / Skill for those rows and the prose (whys[1] 'Still even', whys[2] 'this one window is his', whys[3] 'trade evenly') already agrees with the packet, not the labels.
audit.why: Aatrox's level-3 spike (Infernal Chains into the outer-edge Q3 plus Deathbringer Stance heal) beats a dry Irelia engage before Flawless Duet is reliable. Levels 1-2 and 4-5 are even.
audit.corrected: Rows 1/2/3 flipped to Skill / Aatrox / Skill in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 3 (his), Lvl 6 (Vanguard's Edge), first-item Blade of the Ruined King, 2+ items (his World Ender drain). All four exist and match the mirror's account of Vanguard's Edge on 125s and World Ender beating Bladesurge resets.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were never stated: Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) grounds Irelia so Bladesurge cannot be cast, and Flawless Duet's stun (E, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) locks Aatrox out of Umbral Dash (E, 9/8/7/6/5s) for its duration. The Deathbringer Stance auto-reset wind-up as the burst tell was also absent.
audit.why: Riot's text confirms Aatrox W drags champions to the centre and carries grounding, and that Irelia E damages, stuns and Marks. I claim only the stun for Irelia's side — the 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet contradicts Riot's own description of that ability and I did not rely on it.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[1], dontsFull[0] and wants.you[1]/[2] with real cooldown numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d talked about burning your own ultimate under a heading about fighting his R without anti-heal.
audit.why: World Ender is 120s at rank 1 and extends on takedown; Grievous Wounds is the actual answer.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to name the 120s cooldown and Executioner's Calling.

audit.why: Both flagged suspectNames are false positives: World Ender and Vanguard's Edge are the real Riot names; only the hyphenated 'World-Ender' styling in wants.you[2] was off, and that line was rewritten anyway.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Aatrox's World Ender is down.
edits.after: Even: Defiant Dance blunts his physical Q, but with no Flawless Duet yet you farm Bladesurge resets, not trades into his Q3.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His spike, not yours: Infernal Chains grounds your Bladesurge, then Q3's outer edge lands. Hold Defiant Dance for it and farm to 4.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Aatrox when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Infernal Chains (20s at rank 1) grounds you — Bladesurge in before it lands or after it expires, then reset through the wave.

edits.before: That is Aatrox's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Outer edge is his damage and heal — his Deathbringer auto wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: World Ender is 120s and heals through your DPS — buy Executioner's.

edits.before: Fight only when World Ender is down — a no-R Aatrox can't out-sustain your ramped on-hit, and his sweetspot Q is far easier to W-block without ult stats behind it
edits.after: Fight when World Ender is down — Flawless Duet's stun locks Umbral Dash (5s at rank 5) shut, so a no-R Aatrox can't escape or out-sustain your on-hit

edits.before: Use Vanguard's Edge at 6 to wall off his World-Ender dash escape, then chain E-stun into a full Q-reset combo for the kill
edits.after: Wall off his Umbral Dash escape with Vanguard's Edge at 6, then chain Flawless Duet's stun into a full Bladesurge-reset combo

notes: Both packet suspectNames are false positives — World Ender and Vanguard's Edge are the correct Riot names. Level-chart rows 1/2/3 were proposed as one paired full+content group.
